steps.beforeInstructorMessage: Look at the table: the pot is $100 and your call is $100. We want the break-even win rate—the percentage you must win for the call to be neutral (a coin flip).
steps.question: Pot $100, call $100. What win rate (%) do you need to break even on a call? Pick one.

gradingSpecJson.responseCorrect: Correct. You're calling $100 to win $100 (the pot). You're putting in half the final pot, so you need to win 50% of the time to break even—a coin flip. Only call with a real edge.
gradingSpecJson.responseIncorrect: Not quite. You call $100; the pot is $100, so the final pot is $200. You're putting in half, so you need to win half the time (50%) to break even.
gradingSpecJson.followUpContent: Pot $100, you call $100. Final pot is $200 and you contributed half, so you need to win 50% of the time to break even. Poker IQ: at 50% you need a genuine hand or a very strong draw. Don't call "to see a card" or with a weak draw here—you're paying maximum price. Save those calls for when you're getting better pot odds (e.g. 3:1 or 2:1).
